    At the 2026 Masters, professional golfers who miss the 36-hole cut receive a prize money payout of $25,000. This consistent stipend is awarded to all professionals who do not make it to the weekend, ensuring they leave with compensation from the total purse. 
    Key 2026 Masters Payout Details: 
    • Missed Cut: $25,000
    • Last Place (50th+): Players who make the cut but finish outside the top 50 receive diminishing payouts starting from roughly $56,700 for 50th.
    • Total Purse: $22.5 million 
    Notable players who missed the cut at the 2026 Masters, such as Bryson DeChambeau and others, receive this $25,000 payout
